  "memo":"Recommend clear. R04 holds because the packet identifies a first attempt on a new account with an amount above the category percentile reference; it is Context only. All other rule conditions are absent, leaving no adverse families. The AVS failure lacks R03's geographic mismatch. Device and address linkage counts do not trigger their rules, so no household exception is needed. No earlier outcome settles the order, and no checks have completed. Ordinary new-customer onboarding is more plausible than stolen-card use on the available evidence. No installments were due, so non-payment cannot support action. FP-2 §6.6(c) requires clear; no verification check is needed."
